name: hud_sensor_tracker_draw_marker_cross
description: HudSensorTracker::DrawMarkerCross draws horizontal and vertical clipped line-strip arms around a marker center.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation at 0x416dd0 has no warnings or tags and builds a horizontal two-point line strip, then a vertical two-point line strip, forwarding markerColor masked to 16 bits.
The direct callee zRndr_DrawClippedImmediateLineStrip is functional-equivalent through target zrndr_draw_clipped_immediate_line_strip.
The native HUD save-marker leaf smoke verifies both emitted cross arms, tracker clip-rect forwarding, active framebuffer forwarding, and low 16-bit color masking.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x416dd0 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
